item.text:
**8B.8 Research Note: Bongbong Marcos, 2024**

**Direction of travel:** mixed to moderately positive. Marcos did show repeated course-correction in administrative and economic domains, especially when rice, disaster, or security tactics looked weak. The main weakness is that some civic-space and accountability failures were not meaningfully corrected.

**Positive evidence**

- [PBBM stands by suspension of 139 NFA officials](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-stands-by-suspension-of-139-nfa-officials/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-03-06 | Marcos backed mass suspensions after anomalous rice sales and procedural violations, showing willingness to replace or discipline ineffective implementers rather than shield them. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [EO No. 52: Institutionalizing the Pag-Abot Program](https://lawphil.net/executive/execord/eo2024/eo_52_2024.html) | Lawphil / Office of the President | 2024-01-18 | He turned anti-poverty rhetoric into a standing inter-agency program with monitoring and reporting, which is a real institutional correction rather than one-off symbolism. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [PBBM approves National Cybersecurity Plan to fortify PH against various threats](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-approves-national-cybersecurity-plan-to-fortify-ph-against-various-threats/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-02-08 | The administration moved from general cyber talk to a formal plan with operational guidelines, signaling adjustment from rhetoric to a clearer implementation architecture. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [PBBM to certify RTL as urgent to bring down rice prices](https://mirror.pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-to-certify-rtl-as-urgent-to-bring-down-rice-prices/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-05-06 | After rice inflation stayed severe, Marcos shifted toward changing the Rice Tariffication Law so the state could intervene more directly in rice markets. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.7

- [PBBM to DA, DBM: Expand coverage of gov’t rice programs](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-to-da-dbm-expand-coverage-of-govt-rice-programs/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-11-06 | When the initial rice programs covered too few outlets and households, he ordered expansion and cross-agency coordination, which is a direct tactical adjustment. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.7

- [PBBM to DPWH, DENR: Revise PH’s flood control masterplan](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-to-dpwh-denr-revise-phs-flood-control-masterplan/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-11-14 | After stronger typhoons exposed capacity limits, Marcos ordered a revised flood-control masterplan and higher adaptation capacity. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.7

- [EO No. 74: Ban of POGO/IGL and other offshore gaming operations](https://lawphil.net/executive/execord/eo2024/eo_74_2024.html) | Lawphil | 2024-11-08 | The administration moved from toleration/regulation to a full ban after the sector became associated with crime and abuse, showing a strong corrective turn. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [PBBM refutes alleged loophole in EO 74, reiterates POGO ban in all forms](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-refutes-alleged-loophole-in-eo-74-reiterates-pogo-ban-in-all-forms/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-11-11 | Marcos followed through by closing loophole arguments, which suggests enforcement follow-through rather than symbolic announcement only. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [EO No. 81: Reconstituting the National Security Council](https://lawphil.net/executive/execord/eo2024/eo_81_2024.html) | Lawphil / Office of the President | 2024-12-30 | He reworked the NSC’s composition to improve security coordination, which is a late-year institutional correction after a year of sustained maritime and security pressure. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [PBBM signs laws on streamlining procurement, combatting online scams](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-signs-laws-on-streamlining-procurement-combatting-online-scams/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-07-20 | Marcos retooled procurement into a more standardized, auditable system, which is the clearest general anti-patronage process correction in the record. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [PBBM orders agencies to help COS/JO workers get permanent positions in government](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-orders-agencies-to-help-cos-jo-workers-get-permanent-positions-in-government/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-04-25 | Instead of leaving contract staffing as is, he pushed agencies to regularize workers through training and eligibility, which is a concrete administrative adjustment. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [PBBM orders activation of online platform to monitor El Nino-La Nina phenomena](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-orders-activation-of-online-platform-to-monitor-el-nino-la-nina-phenomena/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-03-26 | Marcos added monitoring and public reporting infrastructure after climate stress worsened, which shows adaptation through measurement rather than inertia. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [PBBM reorganizes inter-agency task force on zero hunger](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-reorganizes-inter-agency-task-force-on-zero-hunger/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-08-09 | He reshuffled the zero-hunger task force to broaden membership and keep implementation moving, which is a textbook course-correction move. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

**Negative evidence**

- [NEDA reduced rice tariffs failed to lower prices](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/money/economy/929579/neda-reduced-rice-tariffs-failed-to-lower-prices/story/) | GMA News Online | 2024-12-10 | The flagship rice intervention had weak retail pass-through, so the course correction was only partially effective and did not fully solve the problem. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.7

- [Sona 2024 fact check](https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1964296/sona-2024-fact-check) | Philippine Daily Inquirer | 2024-07-23 | Independent fact-checking found his rice-price explanation incomplete or inaccurate, and I found no contemporaneous public self-correction; that looks more like defensiveness than correction. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.7

- [No PH cooperation with ICC unless PRRD wants it](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/no-ph-cooperation-with-icc-unless-prrd-wants-it-pbbm/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-11-14 | Marcos refused independent ICC cooperation on the Duterte drug war, showing a willingness to keep accountability tightly controlled when scrutiny got politically sensitive. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [Philippines | Digital News Report 2024](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/philippines) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | Red-tagging, libel pressure, blocked sites, and threats against journalists persisted, so civic-space tactics were not meaningfully corrected despite pro-press rhetoric. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

- [2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Philippines](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128580.html) | U.S. Department of State | 2024 | Credible killings, disappearances, torture, arbitrary detention, and media restrictions remained, which is strong evidence that some coercive practices were not corrected. | QIDs: 8B.8, 8B.6

**Bottom line**

Marcos in 2024 **did adapt** in several important domains: rice policy, disaster response, procurement, social-program delivery, cyber governance, and the security architecture. But the corrections were **uneven**. Where the issue was technocratic or administrative, he often reworked the machinery. Where the issue was accountability or civic repression, the record shows much less correction and more containment.

**Search gap**

The strongest evidence for adaptation comes from official orders and later implementation statements. Independent, outcome-based evaluation of whether each correction actually fixed the problem is thinner, especially for rice and flood control.
